gnosh bridge

  Serve the project's machines, mem and frames view to another harness,
  without a model. Requests come as JSON lines on standard input and replies
  go as JSON lines to standard output; spec/gnosh/bridge.md gives the
  protocol. It ends when standard input ends.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh bridge [flags]

Flags
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
